appLanguage.title: App language
appLanguage.help: The language your app speaks to its visitors. The AI writes new pages in it, features you add are translated into it, and the app's built-in messages use it.
appLanguage.intro: The language your visitors see: pages the AI builds, features you add, and built-in messages like "Sorry, that didn't send".
appLanguage.label: Language of this app
appLanguage.selectHelp: Pick the language your app's visitors read.
appLanguage.notChosen: No language chosen yet, so the app is in English.
appLanguage.rtl: Written right to left: pages are mirrored for it.
appLanguage.note: Pages you already have keep their words. To change them, open a page and ask the AI to translate it.
appLanguage.saveHelp: Saves the language. Built-in messages and the page's language setting change on the live app straight away.
appLanguage.saved: Saved. New pages and features will be in {language}.
appLanguage.saveError: Couldn't save the language. Please try again.
appLanguage.invalid: Choose one of the languages in the list.

buildLanguage.label: App language
buildLanguage.help: The language your app's visitors will read. The AI writes every page in it. You can add more languages later.

preview.title: {title} — Preview
preview.latestLive: Your latest edits · visitors see version {version}

languages.title: More languages
languages.help: Offer your app in several languages. Visitors pick one from the app's menu, and see it at its own address (like /es/).
languages.intro: Offer your app in more languages too. The AI translates every page, and visitors choose a language from the menu. A new language goes live when you publish.
languages.addHelp: Adds the language and has the AI translate every page into it. You can edit each translation in the editor.
languages.translated: {ok, plural, one {# of {total} page translated} other {# of {total} pages translated}}
languages.needUpdate: {count, plural, one {# needs updating} other {# need updating}}
languages.edited: {count, plural, one {# edited by you} other {# edited by you}}
languages.updateHelp: Has the AI translate the pages that are new or changed since they were translated. Pages you edited in this language are kept.
languages.removeHelp: Removes this language and its translated pages from your app.
languages.confirmRemove: Remove {language} and its translated pages? Visitors won't see it after you publish.
languages.publishNote: Publish your app to show changes to languages to visitors.
languages.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
